# anthropic_agents (Data Source)

Lists Managed Agents on the Anthropic platform (beta). Supports filtering by creation time, archive status, and a per-page limit; all pages are fetched automatically.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_at_gte` (String) Return agents created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (inclusive).
- `created_at_lte` (String) Return agents created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp (inclusive).
- `include_archived` (Boolean) Whether to include archived agents in the results. Defaults to `false`.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum results per page. Defaults to `20`, maximum `100`. Pagination is handled automatically across all pages.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) List of Managed Agents matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Read-Only:

- `agent_toolset` (Attributes) Configuration for built-in agent tools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents--agent_toolset))
- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp (RFC 3339). Null if the agent has not been archived.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `custom_tools` (Attributes List) Custom tools executed by the API client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents--custom_tools))
- `description` (String) Description of what the agent does.
- `id` (String) Unique agent identifier assigned by the API.
- `mcp_servers` (Attributes List) MCP servers the agent connects to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents--mcp_servers))
- `mcp_toolsets` (Attributes List) Tool configurations for MCP servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents--mcp_toolsets))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the agent.
- `model` (String) The model that powers the agent.
- `model_speed` (String) Inference speed mode: `standard` or `fast`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the agent.
- `skills` (Attributes List) Skills available to the agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents--skills))
- `system` (String) System prompt for the agent.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `version` (Number) The agent's current version.

<a id="nestedatt--agents--agent_toolset"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents.agent_toolset`

Read-Only:

- `configs` (Attributes List) Per-tool configuration overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents--agent_toolset--configs))
- `default_enabled` (Boolean) Whether tools are enabled by default.
- `default_permission_policy` (String) Default permission policy: `always_allow` or `always_ask`.

<a id="nestedatt--agents--agent_toolset--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents.agent_toolset.configs`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this tool is enabled.
- `name` (String) Built-in tool name.
- `permission_policy` (String) Permission policy: `always_allow` or `always_ask`.



<a id="nestedatt--agents--custom_tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents.custom_tools`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description shown to the agent.
- `input_schema` (String) JSON Schema for the tool's input parameters, encoded as a JSON string.
- `name` (String) Unique tool name.


<a id="nestedatt--agents--mcp_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents.mcp_servers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Unique name of the MCP server.
- `url` (String) Endpoint URL for the MCP server.


<a id="nestedatt--agents--mcp_toolsets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents.mcp_toolsets`

Read-Only:

- `configs` (Attributes List) Per-MCP-tool configuration overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents--mcp_toolsets--configs))
- `default_enabled` (Boolean) Whether MCP tools are enabled by default.
- `default_permission_policy` (String) Default permission policy: `always_allow` or `always_ask`.
- `mcp_server_name` (String) Name of the MCP server.

<a id="nestedatt--agents--mcp_toolsets--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents.mcp_toolsets.configs`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this tool is enabled.
- `name` (String) Name of the MCP tool.
- `permission_policy` (String) Permission policy: `always_allow` or `always_ask`.



<a id="nestedatt--agents--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents.skills`

Read-Only:

- `skill_id` (String) Identifier of the skill.
- `type` (String) Skill type: `anthropic` or `custom`.
- `version` (String) Pinned version of the skill.
